study_identification_part.si_4_title: Neuroanatomical heterogeneity and homogeneity in individuals at clinical high risk for psychosis

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study used the Person-Based Similarity Index (PBSI) with a normative modelling approach to assess the 'normativeness' of neuroanatomical profiles in individuals at CHR-P. The PBSI scores were transformed into z-scores based on the Healthy Control (HC) group.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Personalised estimates of heterogeneity of SA, CT and SV brain profiles were indexed with the novel Person-Based Similarity Index (PBSI)... using a normative modelling approach, to assess the ' normativeness ' of neuroanatomical profiles in individuals at CHR-P.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study analyzed Cortical Surface Area (SA), Cortical Thickness (CT), and Subcortical Volume (SV). Intracranial Volume (ICV) was also analyzed but not using the normative PBSI method (only VR/CV).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We aimed to quantify the neuroanatomical heterogeneity in structural magnetic resonance imaging measures of cortical surface area (SA), cortical thickness (CT), subcortical volume (SV), and intracranial volume (ICV)... Normative PBSI analysis identified 11 CHR-P individuals ... in SA, 118 ... in CT and 161 ... in SV.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Neuroimaging data were adjusted for scanner protocol and site using neuroComBat prior to analysis. The normative PBSI scores were calculated based on the HC group. Age and sex were used as covariates in subsequent association analyses but not explicitly as predictors in the PBSI normative reference itself (beyond the ComBat preservation).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Neuroimaging data were adjusted for scanner protocol and site using neuroComBat [50] ... controlling for group (CHR-P/HC), age and sex. ... The PBSI of the i th individual is the average correlation between his/her brain measures ( yi ) and the brain measures of any other individual of the reference sample
